summary: Iteration 23: Blog SEO module (proxy to external engine) e2e tested. Backend 14/14 pytest cases pass. Frontend blog list/article/404/lead/track flows pass. Admin BlogSettings page shows connected card + masked key, http-URL rejected with https error toast, disconnect flow empties /blog and hides home-latest-articles. Reseller forbidden on /api/admin/blog/settings (403) and 'Blog SEO' hidden in sidebar; direct /app/blog-seo redirects. Key never leaks to public endpoints or page HTML. blog_settings restored after disconnect test. Required a frontend supervisor restart to pick up new routes/components (HMR hadn't flushed PublicCatalog changes).

issues: Duplicate meta tags in <head>: index.html ships default meta description, canonical, og:title/og:description/og:image which are NOT replaced by react-helmet-async — Helmet only appends a second tag with the article values. document.title is correctly overridden, link rel=stylesheet, ld+json, article og:image/og:title/og:description/canonical/description ARE present as second occurrences, but SEO crawlers may read the first (default GoRoky) tag. Consider removing those defaults from public/index.html for article pages or using Helmet attribute-matching so the index.html tags are managed.

action_items: (Optional) Deduplicate article meta tags on /blog/:slug: remove or Helmet-manage the default meta description, canonical and og:* that live in public/index.html, so article values are the only ones in <head>.
critical_code_review_comments: blog.py upstream(): JSON POST merges server key into body (good — frontend never sees it). GET params injection also looks correct and excludes /styles.css.
Mask function uses bullets (•) only when key length > 8 — ok for the 13-char test key.
BlogArticle Helmet duplicates: see design_issues above.

Preview SW/HMR occasionally serves a stale bundle after large UI edits; a `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` was required to surface header-blog-link, footer-blog-link, mobile-blog-link and LatestArticles. Not a code bug but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded blog_settings {_id:'config', api_base:'http://localhost:9999/api/public/site1', key:'testkey123456', enabled:true, brand:'Goroky', published:1} after disconnect test. Mock engine kept running at :9999.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blog proxy and admin BlogSettings fully functional. If re-testing, run tests/test_iter23_blog.py — it both verifies and re-seeds blog_settings. Mock engine lives at /app/backend/tests/mock_blog_engine.py (uvicorn on :9999). Only sub-par item is duplicate head meta tags on /blog/:slug (index.html defaults + Helmet).
rca of the issue: N/A — duplicate head tags come from public/index.html defaults not being managed by react-helmet-async. Fix: either strip those defaults from index.html for article pages or render them inside a top-level <Helmet defaultTitle=... > so BlogArticle's <Helmet> replaces them.
